scope_assumptions: Conditional income-limit slice: upstream household membership is held equal to the observed all-citizen residential group for these explicit fixtures. This module does not model household membership.
Fixture stable_monthly_income and one_residential_economic_unit assumptions apply. Monthly February 2026 limit is multiplied by twelve solely to match the oracle annual-income-limit unit.
2025 fixtures and the excluded-member fixture are unsupported; no PolicyEngine-calculated household size or income is supplied as candidate input.
Ordinary recurring source income only; all observed people remain in the income relation, including the excluded-members fixture. Household legal membership and final benefit are not modeled.
All raw nonzero income must be represented exactly once; household TANF and unmapped income sources are rejected.
The source snapshot is pending encoder acceptance and has known defects outside this bounded ordinary-income slice.

assumptions: One recurring ordinary payment source per observed person income key; monthly amount is annual observation / 12, using the fixture stable_monthly_income declaration.
Employment means ordinary wages, pension means ordinary pension, military retired pay and SBP are separate unearned sources. No source is classified as legally countable by the bridge.
This bounded slice excludes net self-employment, regular interest/dividends and household TANF; any nonzero unmapped source is rejected.
